about.heading: About the Lawyer
about.intro: I am a barrister specializing in criminal law. Practicing in this field since 1978, I have over 45 years of professional experience, providing effective criminal defense.
about.b1_text: Effective representation and defense across a broad range of criminal cases.
about.b2_text: Full defense covering pre-trial investigation, appeal, and cassation proceedings.
about.b3_text: Consultations and defense in criminal law, administrative offenses, and civil claims in criminal proceedings.
